decision.reason: The upstream explicitly describes itself as leaked source and exposes no repository license. AI Factory may study public architectural categories and independently implement generic patterns, but must not vendor or reproduce the upstream implementation.

provenanceRules: No upstream source file may be copied into AI Factory.
No prompt text from the upstream may be copied into AI Factory.
Local implementations must be written against AI Factory contracts and naming.
Any future code-level comparison requires a separate legal/license review before reuse.
This audit records architectural inspiration, not source-code provenance for local implementation.
